test_title: SSC CGL 2022 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On : 08 Dec 2022 Shift 4)
subject: general
question: Which of the following has become the first state in the country to get the L-root server?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Rajasthan.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Rajasthan** has been the first State in the nation to **receive the L-root server, **allowing the **State government to enforce e-governance and offer its signature digital services** with seamless** internet connectivity**.
 
• The new facility will **help increase the security and resilience** of internet-based businesses while strengthening internet infrastructure.
 
• In collaboration with the **Internet Corporation for Assigned Names and Numbers,** the new server has been set up in the Bhamashah State Data Centre here (ICANN).
 
• Following the completion of the new facility, the **State would no longer rely on any root servers for the domain name system, according to Chief Minister Ashok Gehlot.​**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**

 
• L - root is one of the 13 Domain Name System 'root servers' which together make up the infrastructure known as the Root Server System.
 
• A root server is part of the supporting infrastructure of the Internet and facilitates Internet use by acting as the backbone of online access.
